items.title: OpenSSL 4.1.0
items.blurb: General purpose TLS and crypto library. Contribute to openssl/openssl development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: Wild version 0.11.0 released
items.blurb: A very fast linker for Linux and WebAssembly. Contribute to wild-linker/wild development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: eMudhra's Press Release on the CA Compromise
Web Search on AWS Bedrock now supports domain filtering and user location controls
items.blurb: Web Search on AWS Bedrock now supports two new controls that give you more precision over the results that ground a model's response: domain filtering and user location.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now supports persistent chat across linked AWS Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now provides customers a mechanism to deliver long, persistent chat experiences across linked AWS Regions.

items.title: AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN now support 1:1 NAT
items.blurb: AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN now provide managed one-to-one network address translation (NAT) directly on their attachments, through integration with Regional Private NAT Gateway.

items.title: Amazon Corretto October 2026 Quarterly Updates
items.blurb: On October 22, 2026 Amazon announced quarterly security and critical updates for Amazon Corretto Long-Term Supported (LTS) versions of OpenJDK.

items.title: Amazon MWAA now available in Mexico (Central) Region
items.blurb: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) Provisioned environments are now available in the Mexico (Central) Region (mx-central-1).

items.title: Amazon EMR on EKS reduces EMR charge by 30 percent
items.blurb: Amazon EMR announces a reduction of 30 percent in the EMR charge added to EKS when running EMR on EKS.
